## General introduction

Cystic fibrosis (CF) is a genetic disorder caused by pathogenic variants in the CFTR (Cystic Fibrosis Transmembrane Conductance Regulator) gene. CFTR dysfunction leads to impaired ion transport and the production of thick mucus, primarily affecting the lungs and gastrointestinal tract. People with CF (pwCF) commonly develop chronic airway infections and gastrointestinal complications.

In recent years, CFTR modulator therapies—particularly the triple combination elexacaftor-tezacaftor-ivacaftor (ETI) have markedly improved clinical outcomes, especially respiratory function and nutritional status.

In this script, we analyze clinical variables from 35 people with CF (6–66 years) assessed before treatment (T0) and after 12 months of ETI (T12).

*Main question:*

-   *Have clinical variables changed after one year of ETI treatment?*

```{r Load in data lung function, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_demo <- read_delim(here("data", "only_demographics_all.csv"))
```

### Funtion to export statistics
```{r Statistics, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_base <- df_demo %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0","T12"))) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(PatientID) %>%
  dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(Time) == 2) %>%   
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(Time == "T0")                       

n_patients <- dplyr::n_distinct(df_base$PatientID)


fmt_n_pct <- function(x, n_total) {
  n <- sum(!is.na(x))
  if (n == 0) return(NA_character_)
  tb <- table(x, useNA = "no")
  out <- paste0(names(tb), ": ", as.integer(tb), " (", round(100*as.integer(tb)/n_total, 1), "%)")
  paste(out, collapse = "; ")
}

fmt_mean_sd <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  sprintf("%.1f ± %.1f", mean(x), stats::sd(x))
}

fmt_median_iqr <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  q <- stats::quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
  sprintf("%.1f [%.1f–%.1f]", q[2], q[1], q[3])
}

# Normality test (Age at T0; one value per patient)
age_vec <- df_base$Age
age_vec <- age_vec[!is.na(age_vec)]

if (length(age_vec) >= 3) {
  shapiro_age <- shapiro.test(age_vec)
  shapiro_p_age <- unname(shapiro_age$p.value)
  age_is_normal <- shapiro_p_age >= 0.05
} else {
  shapiro_age <- NULL
  shapiro_p_age <- NA_real_
  age_is_normal <- NA
}

cat("\n=== Normality test (Age, T0) ===\n")
cat("n =", length(age_vec), "\n")

if (!is.null(shapiro_age)) {
  print(shapiro_age)
  if (isTRUE(age_is_normal)) {
    cat("Age distribution: Normal (p =", round(shapiro_p_age, 4), ")\n")
  } else {
    cat("Age distribution: Not normal (p =", round(shapiro_p_age, 4), ")\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Not enough values for Shapiro test (n < 3)\n")
}


baseline_stats <- tibble::tibble(
  variable = c(
    "N (paired patients)",
    "Age (years), Shapiro–Wilk p-value",
    "Age (years), mean ± SD",
    "Age (years), median [IQR]",
    "AgeGroup, n (%)",
    "Sex, n (%)",
    "MutationGroup, n (%)",
    "Mutation1, n (%)",
    "Mutation2, n (%)",
    "PI, n (%)",
    "CFLD, n (%)",
    "CFRD, n (%)",
    "coeliac_disease, n (%)",
    "colon_carcinoma, n (%)",
    "mCFTRGroup, n (%)"
  ),
  value = c(
    as.character(n_patients),
    ifelse(is.na(shapiro_p_age), NA_character_, signif(shapiro_p_age, 4)),
    fmt_mean_sd(df_base$Age),
    fmt_median_iqr(df_base$Age),
    fmt_n_pct(df_base$AgeGroup, n_patients),
    fmt_n_pct(df_base$Sex, n_patients),
    fmt_n_pct(df_base$MutationGroup, n_patients),
    fmt_n_pct(df_base$Mutation1, n_patients),
    fmt_n_pct(df_base$Mutation2, n_patients),
    fmt_n_pct(df_base$PI, n_patients),
    fmt_n_pct(df_base$CFLD, n_patients),
    fmt_n_pct(df_base$CFRD, n_patients),
    fmt_n_pct(df_base$coeliac_disease, n_patients),
    fmt_n_pct(df_base$colon_carcinoma, n_patients),
    fmt_n_pct(df_base$mCFTRGroup, n_patients)
  )
)

baseline_stats

if (!dir.exists(here::here("results"))) dir.create(here::here("results"))
readr::write_excel_csv(baseline_stats, here::here("results", "baseline_characteristics_T0.csv"))
```

# ADVERSE EVENTS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Load in the data
```{r , echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_ae <- read_delim(here("data", "adv_events.csv"))
```

### Clean the table and prepare data
```{r Clean the table and prepare data, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Clean the table
df_ae_clean_ae <- df_ae %>%
  mutate(
    Adv_events = trimws(Adv_events),
    Which_AE = na_if(trimws(Which_AE), "NA"),
    Which_AE = na_if(Which_AE, ""),
    AgeGroup = factor(AgeGroup, levels = c("pediatric", "adult"))
  )

# Denominator: unique patients per age group
denom_ae <- df_ae_clean_ae %>%
  distinct(PatientID, AgeGroup) %>%
  count(AgeGroup, name = "n_total_ae")

# Numerator: unique patients with each side effect in each age group
summary_ae <- df_ae_clean_ae %>%
  filter(Adv_events == "Yes", !is.na(Which_AE)) %>%
  distinct(PatientID, AgeGroup, Which_AE) %>%
  count(AgeGroup, Which_AE, name = "n_patients_ae") %>%
  complete(AgeGroup, Which_AE, fill = list(n_patients_ae = 0)) %>%
  left_join(denom_ae, by = "AgeGroup") %>%
  mutate(percent_ae = 100 * n_patients_ae / n_total_ae)

# Order side effects by total frequency
order_ae <- summary_ae %>%
  group_by(Which_AE) %>%
  summarise(total_n_ae = sum(n_patients_ae), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total_n_ae)) %>%
  pull(Which_AE)

summary_ae <- summary_ae %>%
  mutate(
    Which_AE = factor(Which_AE, levels = order_ae),
    Which_AE_label = str_replace_all(as.character(Which_AE), "_", " "),
    Which_AE_label = str_to_title(Which_AE_label)
  )
```

#### Export results
```{r Export results, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
summary_ae_export <- summary_ae %>%
  dplyr::select(
    AgeGroup,
    Which_AE,
    Which_AE_label,
    n_patients_ae,
    n_total_ae,
    percent_ae
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(Which_AE, AgeGroup)

readr::write_csv(
  summary_ae_export,
  here("results", "adv_events_summary_ae_export.csv")
)
```

### Load in the data
```{r Load in data ATB, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_atb <- read_delim(here("data", "ATB.csv"))
```

### Prepare the data
```{r Prepare data, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_atb$Time <- factor(df_atb$Time, levels = c("T0", "T12"))

vars_atb <- c("ATB_inh_oral", "ATB_azi")

df_wide <- df_atb %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, dplyr::all_of(vars_atb)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = PatientID,
    names_from = Time,
    values_from = dplyr::all_of(vars_atb),
    names_sep = "."
  )
```

### Function exact McNemar
```{r Function exact McNemar, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
mcnemar_exact_result <- function(data, varname) {
  
  col_t0  <- paste0(varname, ".T0")
  col_t12 <- paste0(varname, ".T12")
  
  x_t0  <- data[[col_t0]]
  x_t12 <- data[[col_t12]]
  
  keep <- complete.cases(x_t0, x_t12)
  x_t0  <- x_t0[keep]
  x_t12 <- x_t12[keep]
  
  tab <- table(
    factor(x_t0, levels = c(0, 1)),
    factor(x_t12, levels = c(0, 1)),
    dnn = c("T0", "T12")
  )
  
  b <- unname(tab["1", "0"])   # yes in T0, no in T12
  c <- unname(tab["0", "1"])   # no in T0, yes in T12
  
  p_exact <- if ((b + c) == 0) 1 else binom.test(b, b + c, p = 0.5)$p.value
  
  data.frame(
    variable  = varname,
    n         = sum(keep),
    T0_yes    = sum(x_t0 == 1),
    T12_yes   = sum(x_t12 == 1),
    yes_yes   = unname(tab["1", "1"]),
    yes_no    = b,
    no_yes    = c,
    no_no     = unname(tab["0", "0"]),
    p_exact   = p_exact
  )
}
```

#### Run function exact McNemar
```{r Run function, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
results_atb <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  mcnemar_exact_result(df_wide, "ATB_inh_oral"),
  mcnemar_exact_result(df_wide, "ATB_azi")
)

results_atb$p_holm <- p.adjust(results_atb$p_exact, method = "holm")

results_atb <- results_atb %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    variable_label = dplyr::recode(
      variable,
      "ATB_inh_oral" = "Inhaled/oral antibiotics",
      "ATB_azi"      = "Azithromycin"
    ),
    label_stats = paste0(
      "Holm p = ", signif(p_holm, 3),
      "\nYes→No = ", yes_no,
      "\nNo→Yes = ", no_yes
    )
  )

results_atb

results_atb_export <- results_atb %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    T0_pct = round(100 * T0_yes / n, 1),
    T12_pct = round(100 * T12_yes / n, 1),
    T0_n_pct = paste0(T0_yes, "/", n, " (", T0_pct, "%)"),
    T12_n_pct = paste0(T12_yes, "/", n, " (", T12_pct, "%)")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    variable_label,
    n,
    T0_n_pct,
    T12_n_pct,
    yes_yes,
    yes_no,
    no_yes,
    no_no,
    p_exact,
    p_holm
  )

readr::write_csv(results_atb_export, here::here("results", "ATB_T0_vs_T12_stats_HOLM.csv"))
```

### Prepare data for plot
```{r Data for plot, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
plot_df_atb <- df_atb %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, dplyr::all_of(vars_atb)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::all_of(vars_atb),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(variable, Time) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_yes   = sum(value == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_total = sum(!is.na(value)),
    prop    = n_yes / n_total,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    variable_label = dplyr::recode(
      variable,
      "ATB_inh_oral" = "Inhaled/oral antibiotics",
      "ATB_azi"      = "Azithromycin"
    )
  )

ann_df_atb <- results_atb %>%
  dplyr::select(variable_label, label_stats) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    x = 1.5,
    y = 1.08
  )
```

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CULTURES
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
## Dynamics of P. aeruginosa and S. aureus sputum counts
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### Load the data
```{r Load the data, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df <- read_delim(here("data", "cultures_simple.csv"))
```

### Prepare data
```{r Prepare data, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ trimws(.))) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(PatientID),
    !(PatientID %in% c("ONLY PAE", "ONLY SAE", "Pae + Sau a T0"))
  )

cols_counts <- c("Pae_T0","Pae_T12","Sau_T0","Sau_T12")
df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(
    any_of(cols_counts) & where(is.character),
    ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.))
  ))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Pae_any = (coalesce(Pae_T0, 0) > 0 | coalesce(Pae_T12, 0) > 0),
    Sau_any = (coalesce(Sau_T0, 0) > 0 | coalesce(Sau_T12, 0) > 0)
  )

# Create vectors
only_Pae     <- df %>% filter(Pae_any & !Sau_any) %>% pull(PatientID)
only_Sau     <- df %>% filter(Sau_any & !Pae_any) %>% pull(PatientID)
Pae_and_Sau  <- df %>% filter(Pae_any &  Sau_any) %>% pull(PatientID)

only_Pae; only_Sau; Pae_and_Sau
```

#### Only Pae
```{r only_Pae, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
pae_only <- df %>%
  dplyr::filter(PatientID %in% only_Pae) %>%
  dplyr::select(PatientID, Pae_T0, Pae_T12) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(Pae_T0), !is.na(Pae_T12)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(change = dplyr::case_when(
    Pae_T12 > Pae_T0 ~ "up",
    Pae_T12 < Pae_T0 ~ "down",
    TRUE             ~ "no_change"
  ))

tab_pae <- pae_only %>%
  dplyr::count(change) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(n_total = sum(n),
                pct = round(100 * n / n_total, 1))

tab_pae

pae_up_ids   <- pae_only %>% dplyr::filter(change == "up") %>% dplyr::pull(PatientID)
pae_down_ids <- pae_only %>% dplyr::filter(change == "down") %>% dplyr::pull(PatientID)
pae_same_ids <- pae_only %>% dplyr::filter(change == "no_change") %>% dplyr::pull(PatientID)

pae_up_ids; pae_down_ids; pae_same_ids
```

#### Only Sau

### Normality and statistics
#### Only Pae
```{r Normality only_Pae, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df_pae <- df %>%
  filter(PatientID %in% only_Pae) %>%
  transmute(PatientID, T0 = Pae_T0, T12 = Pae_T12) %>%
  filter(!is.na(T0), !is.na(T12)) %>%
  mutate(delta = T12 - T0,
         dir   = case_when(T12 > T0 ~ "up",
                           T12 < T0 ~ "down",
                           TRUE     ~ "no_change"))

sw_all <- shapiro.test(df_pae$delta)

if (sw_all$p.value > 0.05) {
  test_all <- t.test(df_pae$T12, df_pae$T0, paired = TRUE)
  method_all <- "paired t-test"
} else {
  test_all <- wilcox.test(df_pae$T12, df_pae$T0, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)
  method_all <- "Wilcoxon signed-rank"
}

df_pae_up   <- df_pae %>% filter(dir == "up")
df_pae_down <- df_pae %>% filter(dir == "down")

# UP
if (nrow(df_pae_up) >= 3) {
  sw_up <- shapiro.test(df_pae_up$delta)
  if (sw_up$p.value > 0.05) {
    test_up <- t.test(df_pae_up$T12, df_pae_up$T0, paired = TRUE)
    method_up <- "paired t-test"
  } else {
    test_up <- wilcox.test(df_pae_up$T12, df_pae_up$T0, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)
    method_up <- "Wilcoxon signed-rank"
  }
} else {
  sw_up <- list(p.value = NA)
  test_up <- list(statistic = NA, p.value = NA)
  method_up <- "insufficient pairs (<3)"
}

# DOWN
if (nrow(df_pae_down) >= 3) {
  sw_down <- shapiro.test(df_pae_down$delta)
  if (sw_down$p.value > 0.05) {
    test_down <- t.test(df_pae_down$T12, df_pae_down$T0, paired = TRUE)
    method_down <- "paired t-test"
  } else {
    test_down <- wilcox.test(df_pae_down$T12, df_pae_down$T0, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)
    method_down <- "Wilcoxon signed-rank"
  }
} else {
  sw_down <- list(p.value = NA)
  test_down <- list(statistic = NA, p.value = NA)
  method_down <- "insufficient pairs (<3)"
}

res_pae <- tibble::tibble(
  group = c("only_Pae (ALL)", "only_Pae (UP)", "only_Pae (DOWN)"),
  n     = c(nrow(df_pae), nrow(df_pae_up), nrow(df_pae_down)),
  shapiro_p = c(sw_all$p.value, sw_up$p.value, sw_down$p.value),
  test      = c(method_all, method_up, method_down),
  stat      = c(unname(test_all$statistic), unname(test_up$statistic), unname(test_down$statistic)),
  p_value   = c(test_all$p.value, test_up$p.value, test_down$p.value),
  mean_delta   = c(mean(df_pae$delta), mean(df_pae_up$delta), mean(df_pae_down$delta)),
  median_delta = c(median(df_pae$delta), median(df_pae_up$delta), median(df_pae_down$delta))
)

res_pae

readr::write_csv(res_pae, here::here("results", "stats_only_Pae.csv"))
```

### Function for plots
```{r Function for plots, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}}
# 1) Data preparation: reshape counts and annotate subgroups
df_plot <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Pae_T0, Pae_T12, Sau_T0, Sau_T12),
    names_to = c("bug", "Time"), names_sep = "_", values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bug  = recode(bug, Pae = "Pae", Sau = "Sau"),
    Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0","T12")),
    subgroup = case_when(
      PatientID %in% only_Pae    ~ "only_Pae",
      PatientID %in% only_Sau    ~ "only_Sau",
      PatientID %in% Pae_and_Sau ~ "Pae_and_Sau",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(subgroup))

pae_dir <- df %>%
  filter(PatientID %in% only_Pae) %>%
  transmute(PatientID,
            change = case_when(Pae_T12 > Pae_T0 ~ "up", Pae_T12 < Pae_T0 ~ "down", TRUE ~ "no_change"))

sau_dir <- df %>%
  filter(PatientID %in% only_Sau) %>%
  transmute(PatientID,
            change = case_when(Sau_T12 > Sau_T0 ~ "up", Sau_T12 < Sau_T0 ~ "down", TRUE ~ "no_change"))

long_only_pae_dir <- df_plot %>% filter(subgroup == "only_Pae", bug == "Pae") %>% left_join(pae_dir, by = "PatientID")
long_only_sau_dir <- df_plot %>% filter(subgroup == "only_Sau", bug == "Sau") %>% left_join(sau_dir, by = "PatientID")

# 2) Define aesthetics
time_colors <- c("T0" = "#9EC1CF", "T12" = "#F9A1BC")

# 3) Function
create_dot_plot <- function(data, p_value, y_label, title, shape = 21) {
  
  if (is.null(data) || nrow(data) < 2) {
    cat("Skipping plot for '", title, "' due to empty data.\n", sep = "")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  d_paired <- data %>% 
    mutate(
      Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0", "T12")),
      x    = as.numeric(Time),
      count_log10p = log10(count + 1)
    )
  
  y_max <- max(d_paired$count_log10p, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_limit <- y_max * 1.25
  
  p_label <- if (is.null(p_value) || is.na(p_value) || !is.finite(p_value)) {
    "p=N/A"
  } else if (p_value < 0.001) {
    "p<0.001"
  } else {
    paste0("p=", signif(p_value, 3))
  }
  
  p_y_pos <- y_max * 1.10
  
  p <- ggplot(d_paired, aes(x = x, y = count_log10p, group = PatientID)) +
    geom_line(color = "grey40", alpha = 0.5, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(fill = Time),
               shape = shape, size = 3, stroke = 0.5,
               color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
    
    annotate("segment",
             x = 1, xend = 2,
             y = p_y_pos, yend = p_y_pos,
             linewidth = 0.5) +
    annotate("text",
             x = 1.5,
             y = p_y_pos + 0.05 * y_max,
             label = p_label, size = 4) +
    
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("T0", "T12"),
      limits = c(0.5, 2.5)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = pretty(c(0, y_max), n = 5),
      limits = c(0, y_limit)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = time_colors, name = "Time") +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_label, title = title) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  
  return(p)
}
```

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
## Association between ppFEV1 changes and P. aeruginosa dynamics
# ---------------------------------------------------------------

### Load in data
```{r Load in data, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
data_Pae <- read_delim(here("data", "only_Pae_ppFEV1.csv"))
```

### Create categorical variables
```{r Create categorical variables, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
analysis_data_Pae <- data_Pae %>%
  mutate(
    # Variable 1: P. aeruginosa change (Pae Increases vs. Does Not Increase)
    pae_change = factor(case_when(
      Pae_direction == "up"                   ~ "Pae Increases",
      Pae_direction %in% c("down", "neutral") ~ "Pae Does Not Increase",
      TRUE                                    ~ NA_character_
    )),
    
    # Variable 2: FEV1 change (Improves vs. Does Not Improve)
    fev1_improvement = factor(ifelse(ppFEV1_T12 > ppFEV1_T0, "Improves", "Does Not Improve"))
  )

# Create the contingency table
contingency_table_Pae <- table(analysis_data_Pae$pae_change, analysis_data_Pae$fev1_improvement)

print("Contingency Table:")
print(contingency_table_Pae)
```

### Perform Fisher's test
```{r Fisher test, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
fisher_test_result_Pae <- fisher.test(contingency_table_Pae)

# Print the results
print("Fisher's Exact Test Results:")
print(fisher_test_result_Pae)
```

### Normality test and statistics
```{r Shapiro-Wilk, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Filter for patients with a decrease in P. aeruginosa (ONLY 1 INCREASED)
patients_down_Pae <- data_Pae %>%
  filter(Pae_direction == "down")

# Calculate the differences between T12 and T0 (the normality test for a paired analysis is performed on these differences).
differences_Pae <- patients_down_Pae$ppFEV1_T12 - patients_down_Pae$ppFEV1_T0

# Perform the Shapiro-Wilk normality test on the differences
shapiro_result_Pae <- shapiro.test(differences_Pae)

cat("--- Shapiro-Wilk Normality Test Result ---\n")
print(shapiro_result_Pae)
cat("\n")

if (shapiro_result_Pae$p.value > 0.05) {
  
  cat("Data appear to be normally distributed (p > 0.05).\n")
  cat("--- Running Paired t-test ---\n")
  
  final_test_Pae <- t.test(patients_down_Pae$ppFEV1_T12, 
                         patients_down_Pae$ppFEV1_T0, 
                         paired = TRUE, 
                         alternative = "greater")
  
} else {
  
  cat("Data do not appear to be normally distributed (p <= 0.05).\n")
  cat("--- Running Paired Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Test ---\n")
  
  final_test_Pae <- wilcox.test(patients_down_Pae$ppFEV1_T12, 
                              patients_down_Pae$ppFEV1_T0, 
                              paired = TRUE, 
                              alternative = "greater")
}

cat("\n--- Final Statistical Test Result ---\n")
print(final_test_Pae)
```

### Save the results
```{r Save the results, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
readr::write_csv(tibble::tibble(test = final_test_Pae$method,
                                statistic = unname(final_test_Pae$statistic),
                                p_value = final_test_Pae$p.value,
                                n = length(differences_Pae)),
                 here::here("results", "ppFEV1_Pae_down_stats.csv"))
```

#### Load in data

### Create categorical variables
```{r Create categorical variables, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
analysis_data_Sau <- data_Sau %>%
  mutate(
    # Variable 1: S. aureus change (Aureus Increases vs. Does Not Increase)

      Sau_direction == "up"                   ~ "Aureus Increases",
      Sau_direction %in% c("down", "neutral") ~ "Aureus Does Not Increase",

    )),
    
    # Variable 2: FEV1 change (Improves vs. Does Not Improve)
    fev1_improvement = factor(ifelse(ppFEV1_T12 > ppFEV1_T0, "Improves", "Does Not Improve"))
  )

# Create the contingency table
contingency_table_Sau <- table(analysis_data_Sau$sau_change, analysis_data_Sau$fev1_improvement)

# Print the table to verify it's correct
print("Contingency Table:")
print(contingency_table_Sau)
```

### Perform Fisher's test
```{r Fisher test, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
fisher_test_result_Sau <- fisher.test(contingency_table_Sau)

print("Fisher's Exact Test Results:")
print(fisher_test_result_Sau)
```

### Normality test and statistics
```{r Shapiro-Wilk, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Filter for patients with an increase in S. aureus
patients_up_Sau <- data_Sau %>%
  filter(Sau_direction == "up")

# Calculate the differences between T12 and T0 (the normality test for a paired analysis is performed on these differences).
differences_Sau <- patients_up_Sau$ppFEV1_T12 - patients_up_Sau$ppFEV1_T0

# Perform the Shapiro-Wilk normality test on the differences
shapiro_result_Sau <- shapiro.test(differences_Sau)

cat("--- Shapiro-Wilk Normality Test Result ---\n")
print(shapiro_result_Sau)
cat("\n")
if (shapiro_result_Sau$p.value > 0.05) {
  
  cat("Data appear to be normally distributed (p > 0.05).\n")
  cat("--- Running Paired t-test ---\n")
  
  final_test_Sau <- t.test(patients_up_Sau$ppFEV1_T12, 
                         patients_up_Sau$ppFEV1_T0, 
                         paired = TRUE, 
                         alternative = "greater")
  
} else {
  
  cat("Data do not appear to be normally distributed (p <= 0.05).\n")
  cat("--- Running Paired Wilcoxon Signed-Rank Test ---\n")
  
  final_test_Sau <- wilcox.test(patients_up_Sau$ppFEV1_T12, 
                              patients_up_Sau$ppFEV1_T0, 
                              paired = TRUE, 
                              alternative = "greater")
}

cat("\n--- Final Statistical Test Result ---\n")
print(final_test_Sau)
```

### Save the results
```{r Save the results, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
readr::write_csv(tibble::tibble(test = final_test_Sau$method,
                                statistic = unname(final_test_Sau$statistic),
                                p_value = final_test_Sau$p.value,
                                n = length(differences_Sau)),
                 here::here("results", "ppFEV1_Sau_up_stats.csv"))
```

### Function for statistic test
```{r Function for statistic test based on shapiro results lung function, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
auto_paired_test_lung <- function(df,
                                  id_col   = "PatientID",
                                  time_col = "Time",
                                  value_col = "ppFEV1",
                                  levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  stopifnot(all(c(id_col, time_col, value_col) %in% names(df)))
  
  dfw <- df[, c(id_col, time_col, value_col)]
  dfw <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    dfw,
    names_from  = !!rlang::sym(time_col),
    values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)
  )
  if (!all(levels %in% names(dfw))) {
    stop("No columns found ", paste(levels, collapse = " and "), " after pivot_wider().")
  }
  dfw <- dfw[stats::complete.cases(dfw[, levels]), ]
  
  x0   <- dfw[[levels[1]]]
  x12  <- dfw[[levels[2]]]
  diff <- x12 - x0
  n    <- length(diff)
  if (n < 3) stop("Very few valid pairs (n < 3).")
  
  sh     <- shapiro.test(diff)
  normal <- sh$p.value >= 0.05
  
  if (normal) {
    tt <- t.test(x12, x0, paired = TRUE)
    
    mean_diff <- mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_diff   <- stats::sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    d_paired  <- mean_diff / sd_diff
    
    mean_T0  <- mean(x0,  na.rm = TRUE); sd_T0  <- stats::sd(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_T12 <- mean(x12, na.rm = TRUE); sd_T12 <- stats::sd(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Paired t-test\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| t =", round(tt$statistic, 4), "| p =", signif(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T0, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T0, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T12, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T12, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("Mean difference (T12−T0) =", round(mean_diff, 3),
    " | 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ", round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Effect size (Cohen's d paired) =", round(d_paired, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "paired_t",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = tt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(mean = mean_T0, sd = sd_T0),
        T12 = c(mean = mean_T12, sd = sd_T12)
      ),
      mean_diff = mean_diff,
      ci = tt$conf.int,
      effect_size = list(type = "cohen_d_paired", value = d_paired)
    ))
    
  } else {
    wt   <- wilcox.test(x0, x12, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
    V    <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
    r_rb <- 1 - (2 * V) / (n * (n + 1))
    
    med_T0   <- stats::median(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_T12  <- stats::median(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_diff <- stats::median(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Not normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired)\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| V =", V, "| p =", signif(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   median [IQR] = ", round(med_T0, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T0, 3), "–", round(q3_T0, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  median [IQR] = ", round(med_T12, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T12, 3), "–", round(q3_T12, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Median difference (T12−T0) =", round(med_diff, 3), "\n")
    cat("Effect size (rank-biserial r) =", round(r_rb, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "wilcoxon_paired",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = wt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(median = med_T0, Q1 = q1_T0, Q3 = q3_T0),
        T12 = c(median = med_T12, Q1 = q1_T12, Q3 = q3_T12)
      ),
      median_diff = med_diff,
      effect_size = list(type = "rank_biserial_r", value = r_rb, V = V)
    ))
  }
}
# Wrapper "safe": if n < 3, returns a valid res_obj object with p = NA instead of stopping
auto_paired_test_lung_safe <- function(df,
                                       id_col   = "PatientID",
                                       time_col = "Time",
                                       value_col = "ppFEV1",
                                       levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  tryCatch(
    auto_paired_test_lung(df,
                          id_col = id_col,
                          time_col = time_col,
                          value_col = value_col,
                          levels = levels),
    error = function(e) {
      if (grepl("Very few valid pairs", e$message) || grepl("n < 3", e$message)) {
        list(
          variable = value_col,
          method   = "too_few_pairs",
          n        = NA_integer_,
          shapiro  = list(p.value = NA_real_),
          test     = list(statistic = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_),
          effect_size = list(type = NA_character_, value = NA_real_)
        )
      } else {
        stop(e)
      }
    }
  )
}
```

### Function for plot
```{r Function plots, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
make_paired_plot <- function(df, value_var, res_obj, y_lab, outfile) {
  stopifnot(all(c("PatientID","Time", value_var) %in% names(df)))
  
  d <- df %>%
    mutate(Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0","T12"))) %>%
    group_by(PatientID) %>% filter(n_distinct(Time) == 2) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(x = as.numeric(Time))
  
  col_box   <- c("T0" = "#9EC1CF", "T12" = "#F9A1BC")
  col_point <- c("T0" = "#D6E9F5", "T12" = "#FCD6E0")
  
  d <- d %>%
    mutate(
      fill_box   = col_box[Time],
      fill_point = col_point[Time]
    )
  
  p_val   <- res_obj$test$p.value
  p_label <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", signif(p_val, 3)))
  
  y_max    <- max(d[[value_var]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
  p_values <- data.frame(x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_max, label = p_label)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    stat_slab(
      data = d %>% filter(Time == "T0"),
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = fill_box),
      side = "left", alpha = 0.5, adjust = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    stat_slab(
      data = d %>% filter(Time == "T12"),
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = fill_box),
      side = "right", alpha = 0.5, adjust = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = fill_box),
      width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA,
      color = "black", alpha = 0.9, show.legend = TRUE
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = fill_point),
      shape = 21, size = 3, stroke = 0.3, color = "black",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], group = PatientID),
      color = "grey40", alpha = 0.4, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = p_values,
      aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y),
      color = "black", linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = p_values,
      aes(x = (x + xend) / 2, y = y * 1.02, label = label),
      size = 4
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2), labels = c("T0", "T12")) +
    scale_fill_identity(guide = "legend", name = "Time",
                        breaks = col_box, labels = names(col_box)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_lab) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(legend.position = "right",
          axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14))
  
  if (!dir.exists(here("results"))) dir.create(here("results"))
  ggsave(here("results", outfile), p, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 300)
  
  invisible(p)
}
```

### Function for polished panel plots
```{r Function for polish panel plots echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
polish_panel_plot <- function(p) {
  p +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.margin = margin(5.5, 5.5, 5.5, 5.5),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 6))
    )
}
```

### Function plot with shapes for each trajectory
```{r Plots lung function general colored by groups WITH SHAPES, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
make_paired_plot_transcolored <- function(df, value_var, res_obj, y_lab, outfile) {
  stopifnot(all(c("PatientID", "Time", value_var, "group_label") %in% names(df)))
  
  d <- df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0", "T12"))) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(PatientID) %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::n_distinct(Time) == 2) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(x = as.numeric(Time))
  
  p_val   <- res_obj$test$p.value
  p_label <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001", paste0("p = ", signif(p_val, 3)))
  
  y_max    <- max(d[[value_var]], na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05
  p_values <- data.frame(x = 1, xend = 2, y = y_max, label = p_label)
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    ggdist::stat_slab(
      data = d %>% dplyr::filter(Time == "T0"),
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = Time),
      side = "left", alpha = 0.5, adjust = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    ggdist::stat_slab(
      data = d %>% dplyr::filter(Time == "T12"),
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = Time),
      side = "right", alpha = 0.5, adjust = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = Time),
      width = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA,
      color = "black", alpha = 0.9
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("T0" = "#9EC1CF", "T12" = "#F9A1BC"), name = "Time") +
    ggnewscale::new_scale_fill() +
    geom_point(
      data = d %>% dplyr::filter(!is.na(group_label)),
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], fill = Time, shape = group_label),
      size = 3, stroke = 0.5, color = "black"
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("T0" = "#D6E9F5", "T12" = "#FCD6E0"), guide = "none") +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("NM→NM" = 21, "MS→MS" = 24, "MS→NM" = 22),
      name = "Trajectory"
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = .data[[value_var]], group = PatientID),
      color = "grey40", alpha = 0.4, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = p_values,
      aes(x = x, xend = xend, y = y, yend = y),
      color = "black", linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = p_values,
      aes(x = (x + xend) / 2, y = y * 1.02, label = label),
      size = 4
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 2), labels = c("T0", "T12")) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_lab) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "right",
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14)
    )
  
  if (!dir.exists(here("results"))) dir.create(here("results"))
  ggsave(here("results", outfile), p, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 300)
  
  invisible(p)
}
```

### Function to save stats lung 1
```{r Fuction to save stats results lung 1, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Export: lung function (ppFEV1, ppFVC, FEV1/FVC) ===
.build_row_lung <- function(df, value_col, res_obj, subgroup_label = "global",
                            fisher_tab = NULL, cutoff = NA_real_, p_fdr = NA_real_,
                            high_lbl = NULL, low_lbl = NULL) {
  stopifnot(all(c("PatientID","Time", value_col) %in% names(df)))
  is_t <- identical(res_obj$method, "paired_t")

  paired <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12))

  mean_T0  <- mean(paired$T0)
  sd_T0    <- sd(paired$T0)
  mean_T12 <- mean(paired$T12)
  sd_T12   <- sd(paired$T12)

  med_T0 <- median(paired$T0)
  q1_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0, 0.25))
  q3_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0, 0.75))

  med_T12 <- median(paired$T12)
  q1_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.25))
  q3_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.75))

  fmt_group_T0  <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T0, sd_T0) else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T0, q1_T0, q3_T0)
  fmt_group_T12 <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T12, sd_T12) else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T12, q1_T12, q3_T12)

  if (!is.null(fisher_tab)) {
    fisher_res <- fisher.test(fisher_tab, conf.int = TRUE)

    tab_ha <- fisher_tab + 0.5
    a <- tab_ha[high_lbl, "T0"]
    b <- tab_ha[high_lbl, "T12"]
    c <- tab_ha[low_lbl, "T0"]
    d <- tab_ha[low_lbl, "T12"]

    or_ha   <- (a * d) / (b * c)
    se_log  <- sqrt(1/a + 1/b + 1/c + 1/d)
    ci_low  <- exp(log(or_ha) - 1.96 * se_log)
    ci_high <- exp(log(or_ha) + 1.96 * se_log)

    fisher_p       <- as.numeric(fisher_res$p.value)
    fisher_or      <- if (!is.null(fisher_res$estimate)) as.numeric(fisher_res$estimate) else NA_real_
    fisher_ci_low  <- if (!is.null(fisher_res$conf.int)) fisher_res$conf.int[1] else NA_real_
    fisher_ci_high <- if (!is.null(fisher_res$conf.int)) fisher_res$conf.int[2] else NA_real_
  } else {
    fisher_p <- fisher_or <- fisher_ci_low <- fisher_ci_high <- NA_real_
    or_ha <- ci_low <- ci_high <- NA_real_
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    subgroup      = subgroup_label,
    variable      = res_obj$variable,
    method        = res_obj$method,
    n_pairs       = res_obj$n,
    shapiro_p     = unname(res_obj$shapiro$p.value),
    stat          = unname(res_obj$test$statistic),
    p_value       = res_obj$test$p.value,
    group_T0      = fmt_group_T0,
    group_T12     = fmt_group_T12,
    mean_T0       = mean_T0,
    sd_T0         = sd_T0,
    median_T0     = med_T0,
    q1_T0         = q1_T0,
    q3_T0         = q3_T0,
    min_T0        = min(paired$T0),
    max_T0        = max(paired$T0),
    range_T0      = max(paired$T0) - min(paired$T0),
    mean_T12      = mean_T12,
    sd_T12        = sd_T12,
    median_T12    = med_T12,
    q1_T12        = q1_T12,
    q3_T12        = q3_T12,
    min_T12       = min(paired$T12),
    max_T12       = max(paired$T12),
    range_T12     = max(paired$T12) - min(paired$T12),
    diff_estimate = if (is_t) res_obj$mean_diff else res_obj$median_diff,
    ci_low        = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[1] else NA_real_,
    ci_high       = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[2] else NA_real_,
    effect_type   = res_obj$effect_size$type,
    effect_value  = res_obj$effect_size$value,
    fisher_p      = fisher_p,
    fisher_or     = fisher_or,
    fisher_ci_low = fisher_ci_low,
    fisher_ci_high= fisher_ci_high,
    or_ha         = or_ha,
    or_ha_ci_low  = if (!is.null(fisher_tab)) ci_low else NA_real_,
    or_ha_ci_high = if (!is.null(fisher_tab)) ci_high else NA_real_,
    cutoff_used   = cutoff
  )
}
```

```{r Fuction to save stats results lung groups 2, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  med_T12 <- median(paired$T12)

  fmt_group_T0  <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T0, sd_T0) else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T0, q1_T0, q3_T0)
  fmt_group_T12 <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T12, sd_T12) else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T12, q1_T12, q3_T12)

  tibble::tibble(

    ci_high       = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[2] else NA_real_,
    effect_type   = res_obj$effect_size$type,
    effect_value  = res_obj$effect_size$value
  )
}
```

```{r Save stats results lung function, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
row_ppFVC_adu  <- .build_row_lung(df_lung %>% dplyr::filter(AgeGroup == "adult"), "ppFVC", res_ppFVC_adu, subgroup_label = "adult")
row_ratio_adu  <- .build_row_lung(df_lung %>% dplyr::filter(AgeGroup == "adult"), "FEV1_FVC", res_ratio_adu, subgroup_label = "adult")

row_ppFEV1_ped <- .build_row_lung(df_lung %>% dplyr::filter(AgeGroup == "pediatric"), "ppFEV1", res_ppFEV1_ped, subgroup_label = "pediatric")
row_ppFVC_ped  <- .build_row_lung(df_lung %>% dplyr::filter(AgeGroup == "pediatric"), "ppFVC", res_ppFVC_ped, subgroup_label = "pediatric")
row_ratio_ped  <- .build_row_lung(df_lung %>% dplyr::filter(AgeGroup == "pediatric"), "FEV1_FVC", res_ratio_ped, subgroup_label = "pediatric")

lung_stats <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  row_ppFEV1, row_ppFVC, row_ratio,
  row_ppFEV1_fem, row_ppFVC_fem, row_ratio_fem,
  row_ppFEV1_mal, row_ppFVC_mal, row_ratio_mal,
  row_ppFEV1_adu, row_ppFVC_adu, row_ratio_adu,
  row_ppFEV1_ped, row_ppFVC_ped, row_ratio_ped
)

lung_stats$p_fdr <- p.adjust(lung_stats$p_value, method = "BH")

if (!dir.exists(here("results"))) dir.create(here("results"))
readr::write_excel_csv(lung_stats, here("results", "lung_function_stats_complete_without_lunggroups.csv"))
```

### Function for statistic test
```{r Function for statistic test based on shapiro results trans, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
auto_paired_test_trans <- function(df,
                                   id_col   = "PatientID",
                                   time_col = "Time",
                                   value_col = "ALT",
                                   levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  stopifnot(all(c(id_col, time_col, value_col) %in% names(df)))
  
  dfw <- df[, c(id_col, time_col, value_col)]
  dfw <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    dfw,
    names_from  = !!rlang::sym(time_col),
    values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)
  )
  if (!all(levels %in% names(dfw))) {
    stop("No columns found ", paste(levels, collapse = " and "), " after pivot_wider().")
  }
  dfw <- dfw[stats::complete.cases(dfw[, levels]), ]
  
  x0   <- dfw[[levels[1]]]
  x12  <- dfw[[levels[2]]]
  diff <- x12 - x0
  n    <- length(diff)
  if (n < 3) stop("Very few valid pairs (n < 3).")
  
  sh     <- shapiro.test(diff)
  normal <- sh$p.value >= 0.05
  
  if (normal) {
    tt        <- t.test(x12, x0, paired = TRUE)
    mean_diff <- mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_diff   <- stats::sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    d_paired  <- mean_diff / sd_diff
    
    mean_T0  <- mean(x0,  na.rm = TRUE); sd_T0  <- stats::sd(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_T12 <- mean(x12, na.rm = TRUE); sd_T12 <- stats::sd(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Paired t-test\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| t =", round(tt$statistic, 4), "| p =", signif(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T0, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T0, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T12, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T12, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("Mean difference (T12−T0) =", round(mean_diff, 3),
        " | 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ", round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Effect size (Cohen's d paired) =", round(d_paired, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "paired_t",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = tt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(mean = mean_T0, sd = sd_T0),
        T12 = c(mean = mean_T12, sd = sd_T12)
      ),
      mean_diff = mean_diff,
      ci = tt$conf.int,
      effect_size = list(type = "cohen_d_paired", value = d_paired)
    ))
    
  } else {
    wt   <- wilcox.test(x0, x12, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
    V    <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
    r_rb <- 1 - (2 * V) / (n * (n + 1))
    
    med_T0   <- stats::median(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_T12  <- stats::median(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_diff <- stats::median(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Not normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired)\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| V =", V, "| p =", signif(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   median [IQR] = ", round(med_T0, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T0, 3), "–", round(q3_T0, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  median [IQR] = ", round(med_T12, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T12, 3), "–", round(q3_T12, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Median difference (T12−T0) =", round(med_diff, 3), "\n")
    cat("Effect size (rank-biserial r) =", round(r_rb, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "wilcoxon_paired",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = wt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(median = med_T0, Q1 = q1_T0, Q3 = q3_T0),
        T12 = c(median = med_T12, Q1 = q1_T12, Q3 = q3_T12)
      ),
      median_diff = med_diff,
      effect_size = list(type = "rank_biserial_r", value = r_rb, V = V)
    ))
  }
}
# Wrapper "safe": if n < 3, returns a valid res_obj object with p = NA instead of stopping
auto_paired_test_trans_safe <- function(df,
                                       id_col   = "PatientID",
                                       time_col = "Time",
                                       value_col = "ALT",
                                       levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  tryCatch(
    auto_paired_test_trans(df,
                          id_col = id_col,
                          time_col = time_col,
                          value_col = value_col,
                          levels = levels),
    error = function(e) {
      if (grepl("Very few valid pairs", e$message) || grepl("n < 3", e$message)) {
        list(
          variable = value_col,
          method   = "too_few_pairs",
          n        = NA_integer_,
          shapiro  = list(p.value = NA_real_),
          test     = list(statistic = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_),
          effect_size = list(type = NA_character_, value = NA_real_)
        )
      } else {
        stop(e)
      }
    }
  )
}
```

#### Manual transformed y-axis plot function with explicit raincloud
```{r Function break y axis trans, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
compress_y_axis <- function(y, break_at = 80, top_actual = 300,
                            top_plot = 120, gap = 7) {
  
  ifelse(
    y <= break_at,
    y,
    break_at + gap +
      ((y - break_at) / (top_actual - break_at)) *
      (top_plot - break_at - gap)
  )
}


make_half_violin_data <- function(d, y_var = "y_plot",
                                  cloud_width = 0.45,
                                  adjust = 0.6,
                                  n = 512) {
  
  out <- lapply(split(d, d$Time), function(dd) {
    
    vals <- dd[[y_var]]
    vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
    
    if (length(unique(vals)) < 2) {
      return(NULL)
    }
    
    dens <- stats::density(
      vals,
      adjust = adjust,
      from = min(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      to = max(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n
    )
    
    dens_scaled <- dens$y / max(dens$y, na.rm = TRUE) * cloud_width
    
    time_value <- as.character(unique(dd$Time)[1])
    x0 <- unique(dd$x)[1]
    fill_box <- unique(dd$fill_box)[1]
    
    # T0 cloud goes to the left, T12 cloud goes to the right
    side <- ifelse(time_value == "T0", -1, 1)
    
    curve_x <- x0 + side * dens_scaled
    
    tibble::tibble(
      Time = time_value,
      fill_box = fill_box,
      x_poly = c(rep(x0, length(dens$x)), rev(curve_x)),
      y_poly = c(dens$x, rev(dens$x))
    )
  })
  
  dplyr::bind_rows(out)
}


make_paired_plot_transformed <- function(df, value_var, res_obj, y_lab,
                                         break_axis = FALSE,
                                         break_at = 80,
                                         top_actual = 300,
                                         top_plot = 120,
                                         gap = 7,
                                         y_breaks_actual = c(0, 20, 40, 60, 80),
                                         show_p = TRUE,
                                         show_legend = TRUE,
                                         show_break_marks = TRUE) {
  
  stopifnot(all(c("PatientID", "Time", value_var) %in% names(df)))
  
  d <- df %>%
    mutate(Time = factor(Time, levels = c("T0", "T12"))) %>%
    group_by(PatientID) %>%
    filter(n_distinct(Time) == 2) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(x = as.numeric(Time))
  
  col_box   <- c("T0" = "#9EC1CF", "T12" = "#F9A1BC")
  col_point <- c("T0" = "#D6E9F5", "T12" = "#FCD6E0")
  
  if (break_axis) {
    d <- d %>%
      mutate(
        y_plot = compress_y_axis(
          .data[[value_var]],
          break_at = break_at,
          top_actual = top_actual,
          top_plot = top_plot,
          gap = gap
        )
      )
    
    y_breaks_plot <- compress_y_axis(
      y_breaks_actual,
      break_at = break_at,
      top_actual = top_actual,
      top_plot = top_plot,
      gap = gap
    )
    
    y_limit_plot <- top_plot
    
  } else {
    d <- d %>%
      mutate(y_plot = .data[[value_var]])
    
    y_breaks_plot <- y_breaks_actual
    y_limit_plot <- max(y_breaks_actual, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  
  d <- d %>%
    mutate(
      fill_box   = col_box[Time],
      fill_point = col_point[Time]
    )
  
  cloud_data <- make_half_violin_data(
    d,
    y_var = "y_plot",
    cloud_width = 0.45,
    adjust = 0.6
  )
  
  p_val <- res_obj$test$p.value
  p_label <- ifelse(
    p_val < 0.001,
    "p < 0.001",
    paste0("p = ", signif(p_val, 3))
  )
  
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_polygon(
      data = cloud_data,
      aes(x = x_poly, y = y_poly, group = Time, fill = fill_box),
      alpha = 0.5,
      color = NA,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = y_plot, fill = fill_box),
      width = 0.5,
      outlier.shape = NA,
      color = "black",
      alpha = 0.9,
      show.legend = show_legend
    ) +
    geom_line(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = y_plot, group = PatientID),
      color = "grey40",
      alpha = 0.4,
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = d,
      aes(x = x, y = y_plot, fill = fill_point),
      shape = 21,
      size = 3,
      stroke = 0.3,
      color = "black",
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = c(1, 2),
      labels = c("T0", "T12"),
      limits = c(0.45, 2.55)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, y_limit_plot),
      breaks = y_breaks_plot,
      labels = y_breaks_actual,
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.03))
    ) +
    scale_fill_identity(
      guide = "legend",
      name = "Time",
      breaks = unname(col_box),
      labels = names(col_box)
    ) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = y_lab) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = ifelse(show_legend, "bottom", "none"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14)
    )
  
  if (show_p) {
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "segment",
        x = 1,
        xend = 2,
        y = 76,
        yend = 76,
        linewidth = 0.5
      ) +
      annotate(
        "text",
        x = 1.5,
        y = 78,
        label = p_label,
        size = 4
      )
  }
  
  if (break_axis && show_break_marks) {
    p <- p +
      annotate(
        "segment",
        x = 0.60,
        xend = 0.65,
        y = break_at + 1.5,
        yend = break_at + 4.5,
        linewidth = 0.6
      ) +
      annotate(
        "segment",
        x = 0.69,
        xend = 0.74,
        y = break_at + 1.5,
        yend = break_at + 4.5,
        linewidth = 0.6
      )
  }
  
  p
}
```

### Save stats results
```{r Save stats results trans, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Export: ALT, AST, GGT ===
.build_row_trans <- function(df, value_col, res_obj, p_fdr = NA_real_) {
  stopifnot(all(c("PatientID","Time", value_col) %in% names(df)))
  is_t <- identical(res_obj$method, "paired_t")

  paired <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12))

  mean_T0  <- mean(paired$T0);  sd_T0  <- sd(paired$T0)
  mean_T12 <- mean(paired$T12); sd_T12 <- sd(paired$T12)

  med_T0 <- median(paired$T0)
  q1_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.25))
  q3_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.75))

  med_T12 <- median(paired$T12)
  q1_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.25))
  q3_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.75))

  fmt_group_T0  <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T0, sd_T0)  else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T0,  q1_T0,  q3_T0)
  fmt_group_T12 <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T12, sd_T12) else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T12, q1_T12, q3_T12)

  tibble::tibble(
    variable      = res_obj$variable,
    method        = res_obj$method,
    n_pairs       = res_obj$n,
    shapiro_p     = unname(res_obj$shapiro$p.value),
    stat          = unname(res_obj$test$statistic),
    p_value       = res_obj$test$p.value,
    group_T0      = fmt_group_T0,
    group_T12     = fmt_group_T12,
    mean_T0  = mean_T0,
    sd_T0    = sd_T0,
    median_T0= med_T0,
    q1_T0    = q1_T0,
    q3_T0    = q3_T0,
    min_T0   = min(paired$T0),
    max_T0   = max(paired$T0),
    range_T0 = max(paired$T0) - min(paired$T0),
    mean_T12   = mean_T12,
    sd_T12     = sd_T12,
    median_T12 = med_T12,
    q1_T12     = q1_T12,
    q3_T12     = q3_T12,
    min_T12    = min(paired$T12),
    max_T12    = max(paired$T12),
    range_T12  = max(paired$T12) - min(paired$T12),
    diff_estimate = if (is_t) res_obj$mean_diff else res_obj$median_diff,
    ci_low        = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[1] else NA_real_,
    ci_high       = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[2] else NA_real_,
    effect_type   = res_obj$effect_size$type,
    effect_value  = res_obj$effect_size$value
  )
}

row_ALT <- .build_row_trans(df_trans, "ALT", res_ALT)
row_AST <- .build_row_trans(df_trans, "AST", res_AST)
row_GGT <- .build_row_trans(df_trans, "GGT", res_GGT)

trans_stats <- dplyr::bind_rows(row_ALT, row_AST, row_GGT)

trans_stats$p_fdr <- p.adjust(trans_stats$p_value, method = "BH")

if (!dir.exists(here("results"))) dir.create(here("results"))
readr::write_excel_csv(trans_stats, here("results", "transaminases_stats.csv"))
```

### Function for statistic test
```{r Function for statistic test based on shapiro results calpro, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
auto_paired_test_calpro <- function(df,
                                    id_col   = "PatientID",
                                    time_col = "Time",
                                    value_col = "Calprotectin",
                                    levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  stopifnot(all(c(id_col, time_col, value_col) %in% names(df)))
  
  dfw <- df[, c(id_col, time_col, value_col)]
  dfw <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    dfw,
    names_from  = !!rlang::sym(time_col),
    values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)
  )
  if (!all(levels %in% names(dfw))) {
    stop("No columns found ", paste(levels, collapse = " and "), " after pivot_wider().")
  }
  dfw <- dfw[stats::complete.cases(dfw[, levels]), ]
  
  x0   <- dfw[[levels[1]]]
  x12  <- dfw[[levels[2]]]
  diff <- x12 - x0
  n    <- length(diff)
  if (n < 3) stop("Very few valid pairs (n < 3).")
  
  sh     <- shapiro.test(diff)
  normal <- sh$p.value >= 0.05
  
  if (normal) {
    tt        <- t.test(x12, x0, paired = TRUE)
    mean_diff <- mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_diff   <- stats::sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    d_paired  <- mean_diff / sd_diff
    
    mean_T0  <- mean(x0,  na.rm = TRUE); sd_T0  <- stats::sd(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_T12 <- mean(x12, na.rm = TRUE); sd_T12 <- stats::sd(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Paired t-test\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| t =", round(tt$statistic, 4), "| p =", signif(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T0, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T0, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T12, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T12, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("Mean difference (T12−T0) =", round(mean_diff, 3),
        " | 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ", round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Effect size (Cohen's d paired) =", round(d_paired, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(variable = value_col, method = "paired_t",
                   n = n, shapiro = sh, test = tt,
                   group_summary = list(
                     T0  = c(mean = mean_T0, sd = sd_T0),
                     T12 = c(mean = mean_T12, sd = sd_T12)
                   ),
                   mean_diff = mean_diff, ci = tt$conf.int,
                   effect_size = list(type = "cohen_d_paired", value = d_paired)))
    
  } else {
    wt   <- wilcox.test(x0, x12, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
    V    <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
    r_rb <- 1 - (2 * V) / (n * (n + 1))
    
    med_T0   <- stats::median(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_T12  <- stats::median(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_diff <- stats::median(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Not normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired)\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| V =", V, "| p =", signif(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   median [IQR] = ", round(med_T0, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T0, 3), "–", round(q3_T0, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  median [IQR] = ", round(med_T12, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T12, 3), "–", round(q3_T12, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Median difference (T12−T0) =", round(med_diff, 3), "\n")
    cat("Effect size (rank-biserial r) =", round(r_rb, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(variable = value_col, method = "wilcoxon_paired",
                   n = n, shapiro = sh, test = wt,
                   group_summary = list(
                     T0  = c(median = med_T0, Q1 = q1_T0, Q3 = q3_T0),
                     T12 = c(median = med_T12, Q1 = q1_T12, Q3 = q3_T12)
                   ),
                   median_diff = med_diff,
                   effect_size = list(type = "rank_biserial_r", value = r_rb, V = V)))
  }
}
# Wrapper "safe": if n < 3, returns a valid res_obj object with p = NA instead of stopping
auto_paired_test_calpro_safe <- function(df,
                                       id_col   = "PatientID",
                                       time_col = "Time",
                                       value_col = "Calprotectin",
                                       levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  tryCatch(
    auto_paired_test_calpro(df,
                          id_col = id_col,
                          time_col = time_col,
                          value_col = value_col,
                          levels = levels),
    error = function(e) {
      if (grepl("Very few valid pairs", e$message) || grepl("n < 3", e$message)) {
        list(
          variable = value_col,
          method   = "too_few_pairs",
          n        = NA_integer_,
          shapiro  = list(p.value = NA_real_),
          test     = list(statistic = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_),
          effect_size = list(type = NA_character_, value = NA_real_)
        )
      } else {
        stop(e)
      }
    }
  )
}
```

### Function for statistic test
```{r Function for statistic test based on shapiro results elas, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
auto_paired_test_elas <- function(df,
                                  id_col   = "PatientID",
                                  time_col = "Time",
                                  value_col = "Elastase",
                                  levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  stopifnot(all(c(id_col, time_col, value_col) %in% names(df)))
  
  dfw <- df[, c(id_col, time_col, value_col)]
  dfw <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    dfw,
    names_from  = !!rlang::sym(time_col),
    values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)
  )
  if (!all(levels %in% names(dfw))) {
    stop("No columns found ", paste(levels, collapse = " and "), " after pivot_wider().")
  }
  dfw <- dfw[stats::complete.cases(dfw[, levels]), ]
  
  x0   <- dfw[[levels[1]]]
  x12  <- dfw[[levels[2]]]
  diff <- x12 - x0
  n    <- length(diff)
  if (n < 3) stop("Very few valid pairs (n < 3).")
  
  sh     <- shapiro.test(diff)
  normal <- sh$p.value >= 0.05
  
  if (normal) {
    tt        <- t.test(x12, x0, paired = TRUE)
    mean_diff <- mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_diff   <- stats::sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    d_paired  <- mean_diff / sd_diff
    
    mean_T0  <- mean(x0,  na.rm = TRUE); sd_T0  <- stats::sd(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_T12 <- mean(x12, na.rm = TRUE); sd_T12 <- stats::sd(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Paired t-test\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| t =", round(tt$statistic, 4), "| p =", signif(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T0, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T0, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T12, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T12, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("Mean difference (T12−T0) =", round(mean_diff, 3),
        " | 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ", round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Effect size (Cohen's d paired) =", round(d_paired, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "paired_t",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = tt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(mean = mean_T0, sd = sd_T0),
        T12 = c(mean = mean_T12, sd = sd_T12)
      ),
      mean_diff = mean_diff,
      ci = tt$conf.int,
      effect_size = list(type = "cohen_d_paired", value = d_paired)
    ))
    
  } else {
    wt   <- wilcox.test(x0, x12, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
    V    <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
    r_rb <- 1 - (2 * V) / (n * (n + 1))
    
    med_T0   <- stats::median(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_T12  <- stats::median(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_diff <- stats::median(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Not normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired)\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| V =", V, "| p =", signif(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   median [IQR] = ", round(med_T0, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T0, 3), "–", round(q3_T0, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  median [IQR] = ", round(med_T12, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T12, 3), "–", round(q3_T12, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Median difference (T12−T0) =", round(med_diff, 3), "\n")
    cat("Effect size (rank-biserial r) =", round(r_rb, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "wilcoxon_paired",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = wt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(median = med_T0, Q1 = q1_T0, Q3 = q3_T0),
        T12 = c(median = med_T12, Q1 = q1_T12, Q3 = q3_T12)
      ),
      median_diff = med_diff,
      effect_size = list(type = "rank_biserial_r", value = r_rb, V = V)
    ))
  }
}
# Wrapper "safe": if n < 3, returns a valid res_obj object with p = NA instead of stopping

}
```

```{r Function for statistic test based on shapiro results Z-scores, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(mean = mean_T0, sd = sd_T0),
        T12 = c(mean = mean_T12, sd = sd_T12)
      ),
      mean_diff = mean_diff,
      ci = tt$conf.int,
      effect_size = list(type = "cohen_d_paired", value = d_paired)
    ))
    
  } else {
    wt   <- wilcox.test(x0, x12, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
    V    <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
    r_rb <- 1 - (2 * V) / (n * (n + 1))
    
    med_T0   <- stats::median(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_T12  <- stats::median(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_diff <- stats::median(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Not normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired)\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| V =", V, "| p =", signif(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   median [IQR] = ", round(med_T0, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T0, 3), "–", round(q3_T0, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  median [IQR] = ", round(med_T12, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T12, 3), "–", round(q3_T12, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Median difference (T12−T0) =", round(med_diff, 3), "\n")
    cat("Effect size (rank-biserial r) =", round(r_rb, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "wilcoxon_paired",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = wt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(median = med_T0, Q1 = q1_T0, Q3 = q3_T0),
        T12 = c(median = med_T12, Q1 = q1_T12, Q3 = q3_T12)
      ),
      median_diff = med_diff,
      effect_size = list(type = "rank_biserial_r", value = r_rb, V = V)
    ))
  }
}
# Wrapper "safe": if n < 3, returns a valid res_obj object with p = NA instead of stopping
```

### Save stats results
```{r Save stats results z_score, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Export: anthropometry (weight, height, BMI) ===

.build_row_bmi <- function(df, value_col, res_obj, p_fdr = NA_real_) {
  stopifnot(all(c("PatientID","Time", value_col) %in% names(df)))
  is_t <- identical(res_obj$method, "paired_t")

  paired <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12))

  mean_T0  <- mean(paired$T0);  sd_T0  <- sd(paired$T0)
  mean_T12 <- mean(paired$T12); sd_T12 <- sd(paired$T12)

  med_T0 <- median(paired$T0)
  q1_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.25))
  q3_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.75))

  med_T12 <- median(paired$T12)
  q1_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.25))
  q3_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.75))

  fmt_group_T0  <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T0, sd_T0)  else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T0,  q1_T0,  q3_T0)
  fmt_group_T12 <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T12, sd_T12) else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T12, q1_T12, q3_T12)

  tibble::tibble(
    variable      = res_obj$variable,
    method        = res_obj$method,
    n_pairs       = res_obj$n,
    shapiro_p     = unname(res_obj$shapiro$p.value),
    stat          = unname(res_obj$test$statistic),
    p_value       = res_obj$test$p.value,
    group_T0      = fmt_group_T0,
    group_T12     = fmt_group_T12,
    mean_T0  = mean_T0,
    sd_T0    = sd_T0,
    median_T0= med_T0,
    q1_T0    = q1_T0,
    q3_T0    = q3_T0,
    min_T0   = min(paired$T0),
    max_T0   = max(paired$T0),
    range_T0 = max(paired$T0) - min(paired$T0),
    mean_T12   = mean_T12,
    sd_T12     = sd_T12,
    median_T12 = med_T12,
    q1_T12     = q1_T12,
    q3_T12     = q3_T12,
    min_T12    = min(paired$T12),
    max_T12    = max(paired$T12),
    range_T12  = max(paired$T12) - min(paired$T12),
    diff_estimate = if (is_t) res_obj$mean_diff else res_obj$median_diff,
    ci_low        = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[1] else NA_real_,
    ci_high       = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[2] else NA_real_,
    effect_type   = res_obj$effect_size$type,
    effect_value  = res_obj$effect_size$value
  )
}

row_bmi_wt <- .build_row_bmi(df_bmi, "Weight_kg", res_bmi_wt)
row_bmi_ht <- .build_row_bmi(df_bmi, "Height_cm", res_bmi_ht)
row_bmi_bmi <- .build_row_bmi(df_bmi, "BMI_kgm2", res_bmi_bmi)

bmi_stats <- dplyr::bind_rows(row_bmi_wt, row_bmi_ht, row_bmi_bmi)

bmi_stats$p_fdr <- p.adjust(bmi_stats$p_value, method = "BH")

if (!dir.exists(here("results"))) dir.create(here("results"))
readr::write_excel_csv(bmi_stats, here("results", "bmi_stats.csv"))
```

### Load in the data


### Filter data by time

```{r Filter data by time Z-scores, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
data_z_T0  <- subset(df_z, Time == "T0")
data_z_T12 <- subset(df_z, Time == "T12")
```

#### Function for statistic test
```{r Function for statistic test based on shapiro results Z-scores, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
auto_paired_test_z <- function(df,
                               id_col   = "PatientID",
                               time_col = "Time",
                               value_col = "SD_z_score_BMI_2010",
                               levels   = c("T0","T12")) {
  stopifnot(all(c(id_col, time_col, value_col) %in% names(df)))
  
  dfw <- df[, c(id_col, time_col, value_col)]
  dfw <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    dfw,
    names_from  = !!rlang::sym(time_col),
    values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)
  )
  if (!all(levels %in% names(dfw))) {
    stop("No columns found ", paste(levels, collapse = " and "), " after pivot_wider().")
  }
  dfw <- dfw[stats::complete.cases(dfw[, levels]), ]
  
  x0   <- dfw[[levels[1]]]
  x12  <- dfw[[levels[2]]]
  diff <- x12 - x0
  n    <- length(diff)
  if (n < 3) stop("Very few valid pairs (n < 3).")
  
  sh     <- shapiro.test(diff)
  normal <- sh$p.value >= 0.05
  
  if (normal) {
    tt        <- t.test(x12, x0, paired = TRUE)
    mean_diff <- mean(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    sd_diff   <- stats::sd(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    d_paired  <- mean_diff / sd_diff
    
    mean_T0  <- mean(x0,  na.rm = TRUE); sd_T0  <- stats::sd(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    mean_T12 <- mean(x12, na.rm = TRUE); sd_T12 <- stats::sd(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Paired t-test\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| t =", round(tt$statistic, 4), "| p =", signif(tt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T0, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T0, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  mean ± SD = ", round(mean_T12, 3), " ± ", round(sd_T12, 3), "\n", sep = "")
    cat("Mean difference (T12−T0) =", round(mean_diff, 3),
        " | 95% CI [", round(tt$conf.int[1], 3), ", ", round(tt$conf.int[2], 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Effect size (Cohen's d paired) =", round(d_paired, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "paired_t",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = tt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(mean = mean_T0, sd = sd_T0),
        T12 = c(mean = mean_T12, sd = sd_T12)
      ),
      mean_diff = mean_diff,
      ci = tt$conf.int,
      effect_size = list(type = "cohen_d_paired", value = d_paired)
    ))
    
  } else {
    wt   <- wilcox.test(x0, x12, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE, correct = FALSE)
    V    <- as.numeric(wt$statistic)
    r_rb <- 1 - (2 * V) / (n * (n + 1))
    
    med_T0   <- stats::median(x0,  na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T0    <- stats::quantile(x0,  0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_T12  <- stats::median(x12, na.rm = TRUE)
    q1_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
    q3_T12   <- stats::quantile(x12, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
    med_diff <- stats::median(diff, na.rm = TRUE)
    
    cat("\n=== Auto test (", value_col, ") ===\n", sep = "")
    cat("Normality of differences: Not normal (Shapiro p =", round(sh$p.value, 4), ")\n")
    cat("Chosen test: Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired)\n")
    cat("n =", n, "| V =", V, "| p =", signif(wt$p.value, 4), "\n")
    cat("T0:   median [IQR] = ", round(med_T0, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T0, 3), "–", round(q3_T0, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("T12:  median [IQR] = ", round(med_T12, 3), " [",
        round(q1_T12, 3), "–", round(q3_T12, 3), "]\n", sep = "")
    cat("Median difference (T12−T0) =", round(med_diff, 3), "\n")
    cat("Effect size (rank-biserial r) =", round(r_rb, 3), "\n")
    
    invisible(list(
      variable = value_col,
      method = "wilcoxon_paired",
      n = n,
      shapiro = sh,
      test = wt,
      group_summary = list(
        T0  = c(median = med_T0, Q1 = q1_T0, Q3 = q3_T0),
        T12 = c(median = med_T12, Q1 = q1_T12, Q3 = q3_T12)
      ),
      median_diff = med_diff,
      effect_size = list(type = "rank_biserial_r", value = r_rb, V = V)
    ))
  }
}
# Wrapper "safe": if n < 3, returns a valid res_obj object with p = NA instead of stopping
auto_paired_test_z_safe <- function(df,

                                       levels   = c("T0","T12")) {

    auto_paired_test_z(df,
                          id_col = id_col,
                          time_col = time_col,
                          value_col = value_col,

    error = function(e) {
      if (grepl("Very few valid pairs", e$message) || grepl("n < 3", e$message)) {
        list(
          variable = value_col,
          method   = "too_few_pairs",
          n        = NA_integer_,
          shapiro  = list(p.value = NA_real_),
          test     = list(statistic = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_),
          effect_size = list(type = NA_character_, value = NA_real_)
        )
      } else {
        stop(e)
      }
    }
  )
}
```

```{r Alternative plot Z-scores, echo=TRUE, results='show', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Set colors
col_box   <- c("T0" = "#9EC1CF", "T12" = "#F9A1BC")
col_point <- c("T0" = "#D6E9F5", "T12" = "#FCD6E0")

# Long format
z_long <- df_z %>%
  dplyr::select(

    aes(x = x, y = med, color = Time),
    shape = 23, size = 4.0, fill = "white", stroke = 1.0
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = anno_df,
    aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y),
    linewidth = 0.8, color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = anno_df,
    aes(x = x0, y = y + 0.08, label = p_label),
    size = 4.2, color = "black"
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(values = col_box, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = col_point, name = "Time") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 3.5),
    breaks = 1:length(levels(z_long$marker)),
    labels = levels(z_long$marker),
    minor_breaks = sort(c(
      1 - offset, 1 + offset,
      2 - offset, 2 + offset,
      3 - offset, 3 + offset,
      1.5, 2.5))
    ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "z-score (SD units)")

p_zscores_all

ggplot2::ggsave(
  here::here("results", "anthropometry_zscores_T0_T12_combined.svg"),
  p_zscores_all, width = 9, height = 4.5, bg = "white"
)
```
