### Save stats results
```{r Save stats results z_score, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# === Export: z-scores (weight, height, BMI) ===

.build_row_z <- function(df, value_col, res_obj, fisher_tab = NULL, cutoff = NA_real_, p_fdr = NA_real_) {
  stopifnot(all(c("PatientID","Time", value_col) %in% names(df)))
  is_t <- identical(res_obj$method, "paired_t")

  paired <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(PatientID, Time, !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Time, values_from = !!rlang::sym(value_col)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(stats::complete.cases(T0, T12))

  mean_T0  <- mean(paired$T0);  sd_T0  <- sd(paired$T0)
  mean_T12 <- mean(paired$T12); sd_T12 <- sd(paired$T12)

  med_T0 <- median(paired$T0)
  q1_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.25))
  q3_T0  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T0,  0.75))

  med_T12 <- median(paired$T12)
  q1_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.25))
  q3_T12  <- as.numeric(quantile(paired$T12, 0.75))

  fmt_group_T0  <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T0, sd_T0)  else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T0,  q1_T0,  q3_T0)
  fmt_group_T12 <- if (is_t) sprintf("%.3f ± %.3f", mean_T12, sd_T12) else sprintf("%.3f [%0.3f-%0.3f]", med_T12, q1_T12, q3_T12)

  if (!is.null(fisher_tab)) {
    fisher_res <- fisher.test(fisher_tab, conf.int = TRUE)

    tab_ha <- fisher_tab + 0.5

    a <- tab_ha["high_BMIz","T0"];  b <- tab_ha["high_BMIz","T12"]
    c <- tab_ha["low_BMIz","T0"];   d <- tab_ha["low_BMIz","T12"]

    or_ha   <- (a*d) / (b*c)
    se_log  <- sqrt(1/a + 1/b + 1/c + 1/d)
    ci_low  <- exp(log(or_ha) - 1.96 * se_log)
    ci_high <- exp(log(or_ha) + 1.96 * se_log)

    fisher_p      <- as.numeric(fisher_res$p.value)
    fisher_or     <- if (!is.null(fisher_res$estimate)) as.numeric(fisher_res$estimate) else NA_real_
    fisher_ci_low <- if (!is.null(fisher_res$conf.int)) fisher_res$conf.int[1] else NA_real_
    fisher_ci_high<- if (!is.null(fisher_res$conf.int)) fisher_res$conf.int[2] else NA_real_
  } else {
    fisher_p <- fisher_or <- fisher_ci_low <- fisher_ci_high <- NA_real_
    or_ha <- ci_low <- ci_high <- NA_real_
  }

  tibble::tibble(
    variable      = res_obj$variable,
    method        = res_obj$method,
    n_pairs       = res_obj$n,
    shapiro_p     = unname(res_obj$shapiro$p.value),
    stat          = unname(res_obj$test$statistic),
    p_value       = res_obj$test$p.value,
    group_T0      = fmt_group_T0,
    group_T12     = fmt_group_T12,
    mean_T0    = mean_T0,
    sd_T0      = sd_T0,
    median_T0  = med_T0,
    q1_T0      = q1_T0,
    q3_T0      = q3_T0,
    min_T0     = min(paired$T0),
    max_T0     = max(paired$T0),
    range_T0   = max(paired$T0) - min(paired$T0),
    mean_T12   = mean_T12,
    sd_T12     = sd_T12,
    median_T12 = med_T12,
    q1_T12     = q1_T12,
    q3_T12     = q3_T12,
    min_T12    = min(paired$T12),
    max_T12    = max(paired$T12),
    range_T12  = max(paired$T12) - min(paired$T12),
    diff_estimate = if (is_t) res_obj$mean_diff else res_obj$median_diff,
    ci_low        = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[1] else NA_real_,
    ci_high       = if (is_t) res_obj$ci[2] else NA_real_,
    effect_type   = res_obj$effect_size$type,
    effect_value  = res_obj$effect_size$value,
    fisher_p      = fisher_p,
    fisher_or     = fisher_or,
    fisher_ci_low = fisher_ci_low,
    fisher_ci_high= fisher_ci_high,
    or_ha         = or_ha,
    or_ha_ci_low  = if (!is.null(fisher_tab)) ci_low else NA_real_,
    or_ha_ci_high = if (!is.null(fisher_tab)) ci_high else NA_real_,
    cutoff_used   = cutoff
  )
}

row_z_wt  <- .build_row_z(df_z, "SD_z_score_weight_2010",             res_z_wt)
row_z_ht  <- .build_row_z(df_z, "SD_z_score_height_2010",             res_z_ht)
row_z_bmi <- .build_row_z(df_z, "SD_z_score_BMI_2010",      res_z_bmi,
                          fisher_tab = table_bmiz, cutoff = cutoff_z)

z_scores_stats <- dplyr::bind_rows(row_z_wt, row_z_ht, row_z_bmi)

z_scores_stats$p_fdr <- p.adjust(z_scores_stats$p_value, method = "BH")

if (!dir.exists(here("results"))) dir.create(here("results"))
readr::write_excel_csv(z_scores_stats, here("results", "Zscores_pediatrics_stats.csv"))
```

### Including ONLY of interest
```{r Stats results FDR, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 1) Put all your test objects in a single nested list (system -> variables -> res_object)
clinical_tests <- list(
  `Lung function` = list(
    ppFEV1       = res_ppFEV1,
    ppFVC        = res_ppFVC,
    FEV1_FVC     = res_ratio,
    ppFEV1_fem   = res_ppFEV1_fem,
    ppFVC_fem    = res_ppFVC_fem,
    FEV1_FVC_fem = res_ratio_fem,
    ppFEV1_mal   = res_ppFEV1_mal,
    ppFVC_mal    = res_ppFVC_mal,
    FEV1_FVC_mal = res_ratio_mal,
    ppFEV1_adu   = res_ppFEV1_adu,
    ppFVC_adu    = res_ppFVC_adu,
    FEV1_FVC_adu = res_ratio_adu,
    ppFEV1_ped   = res_ppFEV1_ped,
    ppFVC_ped    = res_ppFVC_ped,
    FEV1_FVC_ped = res_ratio_ped
  ),
  `Transaminases` = list(
    ALT = res_ALT,
    AST = res_AST,
    GGT = res_GGT
  ),
  `Intestinal inflammation` = list(
    Calprotectin = res_calpro
  ),
  `Absorption markers` = list(
    Elastase = res_elas
  ),
  `Anthropometry_BMI` = list(
    Weight_kg = res_bmi_wt,
    Height_cm = res_bmi_ht,
    BMI_kgm2 = res_bmi_bmi
  ),
  `Anthropometry_zscore` = list(
    SD_z_score_weight_2010 = res_z_wt,
    SD_z_score_height_2010 = res_z_ht,
    SD_z_score_BMI_2010 = res_z_bmi
  )
)

# 2) Helper to extract p-value (adapt if your object structure differs)
get_p <- function(x) x$test$p.value

# 3) Build one table with all clinical p-values
clinical_pvals <- purrr::imap_dfr(clinical_tests, \(tests, sys) {
  tibble::tibble(
    system   = sys,
    variable = names(tests),
    p_value  = purrr::map_dbl(tests, get_p)
  )
})

# 4) Global BH-FDR across ALL clinical variables together
clinical_pvals_globalFDR <- clinical_pvals %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p_fdr_global = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH"),
    signif_fdr   = p_fdr_global < 0.05
  ) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p_fdr_global)

print(clinical_pvals_globalFDR, n = Inf)

# 5) Save
if (!dir.exists(here::here("results"))) dir.create(here::here("results"))
readr::write_excel_csv(clinical_pvals_globalFDR, here::here("results", "clinical_globalFDR_pvalues.csv"))
```

## Export table
```{r Export final table, echo=TRUE, results='hide', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 0) Collect per-system result tables
results_by_system <- list(
  "Lung function"           = lung_stats,
  "Transaminases"           = trans_stats,
  "Intestinal inflammation" = row_calpro,
  "Absorption markers"      = row_elas,
  "Anthropometry_BMI"       = bmi_stats,
  "Anthropometry_zscore"    = z_scores_stats
)

# 1) Build mega table (do NOT compute BH here)
mega_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(results_by_system, .id = "system") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    system   = stringr::str_trim(system),
    variable = stringr::str_trim(variable)
  )

# 2) Load the GLOBAL FDR table created in your "ONLY of interest" code
global_fdr_tbl <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("results", "clinical_globalFDR_pvalues.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    system   = stringr::str_trim(system),
    variable = stringr::str_trim(variable),
    p_fdr_global
  )

# 3) Keep ONLY rows that exist in the global list + join global FDR + reorder column
mega_tbl_final <- mega_tbl %>%
  dplyr::semi_join(global_fdr_tbl, by = c("system", "variable")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("p_fdr", "p_fdr_global"))) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(global_fdr_tbl, by = c("system", "variable")) %>%
  dplyr::relocate(p_fdr_global, .after = p_value)

# 4) Export (Excel-friendly UTF-8 CSV)
readr::write_excel_csv(
  mega_tbl_final, here::here("results", "clinical_results_mega_table_globalFDR_FINAL.csv"))
```
